resources.string: These switches only show or hide workflows. Turning one off keeps vendors, purchase records, and ledger entries. It does not delete them. Reset is separate and asks before anything is removed.

When this is on, new bills can be paid by cash, UPI, credit, or a split. Credit needs a saved customer. Older bills stay Legacy / unknown until you record a payment yourself. They are not turned into debt automatically.

When this is on, you can keep vendors, quotes, purchase orders, goods receipts, invoices, and vendor balances. Ordering stock is not the same as receiving it, and receiving it is not the same as paying the invoice.
Green: the customer owes the shop. Red: the shop owes the customer or holds an advance.
Green: the vendor owes the shop or the shop holds a credit. Red: the shop owes the vendor.
This bill was saved before payments were tracked. Leaving it as legacy does not create a customer debt.
Enter one amount for each selected type. The amounts must add up exactly to the bill total. One type cannot be split across more than one destination.
Enter a payment that matches the bill total.
Each payment type can be used only once.
Enter an amount greater than zero.
Payment amounts must add up exactly to the bill total.
Credit needs a registered customer. A walk-in sale can be paid in full by cash or UPI.
This bill has saved payments that no longer match the total. Turn Customer Balance Management back on to update them. Existing balances were not changed.
A bill that already has payments cannot be marked legacy.
Enter a quantity, a refund, or a credit adjustment.
Returned quantity is higher than the quantity still on the bill.
This vendor has purchase or balance history, so it was archived instead of deleted.
This customer has balance history. The record was kept.
Add at least one item line.
Check received, damaged, and rejected quantities.
Could not save. Check the amounts and try again.
No ledger entries in this period.
Opening balance added. It was not overwritten.
Payment saved. Allocated %1$s. Unallocated %2$s still reduces the balance.
Archived vendors stay on old purchases. They are hidden from new orders.

Resetting customer balances removes ledger entries, receipts, and bill payment rows, and marks bills as legacy. It does not delete the bills or the customers. Returned stock is reversed. Resetting vendors removes purchase documents and reverses stock that came from goods receipts.
Landed total uses each quoted quantity (at least 1) times the rate, plus delivery charges, minus the quote discount.
Customer balances and vendor purchases are optional. Switching them off hides the screens and keeps the data.

string-array.name: help_accounts_s1
string-array.item: Enable Customer Balance Management to record cash, UPI, credit, and split payments on bills.
Enable Vendor Management for vendors, quotes, orders, receipts, invoices, and vendor balances.
Turning a switch off does not delete ledger entries, vendors, or purchases.

resources.string: The balance is the sum of ledger entries. Green means the customer owes the shop. Red means the shop owes the customer.

string-array.name: help_customer_ledger_s1
string-array.item: Opening balance is added only when you enter it. It is not guessed from old bills.
Cash and UPI on a sale are settled. Only the credit portion increases the balance.
A payment reduces the balance. Anything above the debt stays as an advance.
A sales return can restock goods, refund money, and reduce credit. Those are separate.
Corrections need a reason and stay in the ledger as their own entries.

resources.string: A vendor with purchase or balance history is archived, not deleted.

string-array.name: help_vendors_s1
string-array.item: A purchase order does not add stock.
A goods receipt adds stock only for accepted quantity: received, minus damaged, minus rejected.
A purchase invoice is what you owe. It is separate from the receipt and from the payment.
Quotes can be for one item or many. Comparison shows rates and a landed total that includes delivery charges.

resources.string: When customer balances are enabled, choose cash, UPI, credit, or split before saving.
